scope: One exact-board Windows startup; repeated cold/warm starts and sleep/resume untested.
handoff_evidence: User reports entering Windows after manual U; physical GPU has error code 0 and Driver API benchmarks work. The final pre-Windows check occurs after USB log closure; it has no direct log line.
permission_note: Required WPR_CFG, WPR and FEAT checks passed; FBPA is optional on this board and remained 0xffffff0f. Post-FLR WPR permissions returned to entry values while selectors/effective full-speed readout persisted.
tolerated_timeouts: Two Falcon pre-reset timeouts are explicitly tolerated for HW bug 3419321; subsequent firmware, halt, reset and containment checks passed.
pci_status_note: Offset 0x80 changed 0x92930 to 0x2930, allowed sticky status bits 0x90000 after exactly one FLR.
limits: One GPU and one successful manual-U startup; the two post-start benchmark rounds are not two starts.
FP16/FP32 and TF32 instruction measurements do not establish application speedups.
All-one output checks do not establish general numerical accuracy.
BF16 was not directly benchmarked in this Windows setup.
Clocks were sampled at timed-run boundaries; no continuous telemetry trace was collected.
Repeated cold/warm starts, sleep/resume and sustained stability remain unverified.
